newsitem.title: UK: British Steel gains ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: British Steel gains ahead of results.

text.p: Shares in British Steel Plc rose on Thursday amid buying ahead of its results next week and talk of rising steel prices in Europe, dealers said.
There was also talk that a major investment bank was a buyer of the stock in the options market.
British Steel shares were up 5p or three percent at 157-1/4 by 0938 GMT, the biggest gainer in the FTSE 100 index, in volume of 1.5 million shares.
Dealers pointed out that French steelmaker Usinor Sacilor had earlier this week told shareholders its results should improve in the second half of the year, after a slight drop in first-half profits.
However a report in the Wall Street Journal said U.S. steel prices appeared to be sliding after surging last year. Usinor shares were up 0.36 percent at 97.35 francs by 0945 GMT.
British Steel is expected on Monday to report pre-tax profits of 460 million stg and a dividend of 10p per share.
